stem: In polygon \(ABCDEF\) shown, every angle is a right angle. What is the area of the polygon?
solution: Split the polygon with a horizontal cut at height 4: a 10-by-4 rectangle (area 40) and a 4-by-5 rectangle on top (area 20).
Total area \(= 40 + 20 = 60\). (Check: the 10-by-9 rectangle minus the missing 6-by-5 corner is \(90 - 30 = 60\).)

explanation.A: Correct. A 10-by-4 rectangle plus a 4-by-5 rectangle gives \(40 + 20 = 60\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(90 - 16\): it subtracts a 4-by-4 corner from the 10-by-9 rectangle, but the missing corner is 6 by 5.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(10 \cdot 4 + 4 \cdot 9\); the 4-by-4 square where the two rectangles overlap is counted twice.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(10 \cdot 9\), the area of the whole bounding rectangle, including the missing corner.

verify:
P=figure['points']
o=['A','B','C','D','E','F']
ans=Rational(1,2)*abs(sum(P[o[i]][0]*P[o[(i+1)%6]][1]-P[o[(i+1)%6]][0]*P[o[i]][1] for i in range(6)))
assert P['B'][0]-P['A'][0]==10 and P['C'][1]-P['B'][1]==4 and P['F'][1]-P['A'][1]==9 and P['D'][0]-P['E'][0]==0 and P['E'][0]-P['F'][0]==4
assert ans==10*4+4*(9-4)==60
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
